issues.message: Convert the game to a 540x960 portrait-first phone composition. The playfield must remain 9:16 in 360x800, 390x844, and 430x932 viewports; desktop and landscape should center the same portrait QA shell instead of switching to a horizontal map. Preserve gameplay logic and all seven test controls.
issues.evidence: Validated blueprint orientation=portrait-9:16-first, while generated src/style.css uses 16/9 and 16/10 playfields and contains a landscape two-column rearrangement. Add failing focused tests before implementation, then verify no horizontal overflow, no clipped HUD/core stations, safe-area padding, visible canvas, and no full-screen repeating flash.

consoleLog: Static acceptance audit; no runtime console failure was required to establish the orientation mismatch.
